source_snapshot.items: Retimer firmware upgraded by AC cycle
source_snapshot.procedure: Generic DGX bundle upload to HGX_0 then AC cycle.

old_problem: No retimer serial/inventory, topology path, image/version or rollback is tied to HGX_0.
disposition_reason: Retimer identity and link recovery are core flash semantics; ED-07/16 prohibit inferring them from a generic bundle.
decision_basis: Preserved retimer-specific flash, AC activation and link verification.

test_case.test_name: Retimer firmware update and AC activation
test_case.purpose: Update mapped retimers, activate by approved AC cycle and verify firmware plus every affected PCIe path.
test_case.test_command: Inventory retimers/paths; after flash approval submit scoped image, preserve task status, authorize AC cycle, then verify active versions and link speed/width/errors on every mapped path.
test_case.expected_result: Mapped retimers reach target versions and all affected links recover to expected state without new errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: HGX_0 task success without retimer/link evidence cannot PASS.
test_case.recovery: Use vendor rollback/OOB path; do not continue after task or link failure.

source_conflict.reason: Generic HGX_0 does not identify retimer targets or paths.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Provide retimer topology, image/version, path oracle and recovery.
pending.unlock_condition: Signed retimer flash and path-recovery contract.

project_authority: Retimer inventory and link topology are OEM-specific.
